title: ranunculus arvensis f. tuberculatus
intro: Ranunculus arvensis f. tuberculatus, commonly known as the Corn Buttercup, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Ranunculaceae family. It is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, making it a potential remedy for pain relief and fever reduction. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus arvensis f. tuberculatus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
